text:
noah: quick flag 1: p99 on latency panel popped for /v1/generate EU after we enabled new spill routing. p50/p95 steady, p99 +140ms. small payloads only.
claire: saw it too. chart that merges variants shows the jump, individual variant lines point at q4-batched.
diego: timeline: spill routing ramped 0->25% at 10:50. telemetry-bot: rollout canary-2026-03-23T10:50 -> 25%.
noah: suspect two things: a) tdigest merge may be unweighted; b) batch kernel waiting for small fills on fallback pool.
claire: i pulled raw counts: q4_batched ~ 320 samples, q2-classic ~ 4200 samples in window. if merge is unweighted, small-variant tail will skew blended p99.
diego: confirmed rollup metadata shows merged_sketches: true and merged_count not present. filing PR to include counts in rollup metadata.
telemetry-bot: PR #801 opened by diego: "tdigest merge: preserve sample counts and emit merged_count".
ui-bot: console-UX: can we show "provenance: merged_sketches (unweighted)" on panel while this is unresolved? small badge + hover counts.
claire: short-term mitigation: split dashboard by routing policy (strict vs spillover) and by variant. less blended surprises during rollouts.
sre-oncall: ops mitigation: reduce spill routing to 5% or increase fallback pool capacity; which do we prefer?
diego: lowering to 5% is fastest. i'll queue it and monitor queues.
noah: action items: 1) diego -> telemetry PR and unit test for unequal-count merge; 2) ui-bot -> add provenance badge + sample counts on hover; 3) infra -> reduce spill weight to 5% and watch worker queue depth; 4) claire -> export raw-samples for postmortem.
claire: adding note to rollout runbook: "percentile blending caveat" and reference to telemetry PR.
noah: filed INC-1247, tagging @sre-oncall. will update after raw-sample decomp. :memo:
